claim.text: Approximately 47.9 million people experienced food insecurity in 2024, and household food insecurity remained around 13.7% in the current brief.

outcome_artifact.uncertainty: Food insecurity is a resource-constrained food-access outcome, not a general financial-wellbeing or consumption measure. Annual estimates have sampling error and should be interpreted with the USDA significance guidance.
outcome_artifact.counterinterpretation: The 2024 food-insecurity prevalence was not statistically significantly different from 2023; a small numerical increase is not necessarily a population-level change.
outcome_artifact.rights_boundary: Retain normalized values, source locator, retrieval hash, and derived internal-review calculations with ERS attribution; raw publication reproduction and redistribution remain uncleared.

lineage_adjudication.reason: FRAC may summarize the same USDA series; the direct USDA record is a canonical outcome artifact but is not counted as a second independent publisher until source-level lineage is signed off.
lineage_adjudication.outcome_linkage: food-insecurity outcome is relevant context for community food-service demand but does not measure visits, meals, pantry capacity, enrollment, or provider revenue

required_next_steps: Confirm whether the FRAC record is a restatement of the USDA artifact and record the source lineage.
Acquire a direct community-food-service utilization or capacity outcome with a defined denominator.
Reconcile the outcome period, population, unit, uncertainty, and rights before any IBIS qualification.
boundary: This artifact documents one acquired official outcome context and its limits. It does not validate the IBIS claim, establish demand causality, prove independent confirmation, or authorize an internal company bridge.
